# CANDIDATE: TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO

## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture the edge from trendline breaks in the SPY by introducing a call veto mechanism. The hypothesis is that by blocking calls when a bearish trendline break is confirmed, we can improve the overall performance of the engine.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves adding a new trigger to the engine that detects bearish trendline breaks and vetoes call entries. The trigger will use the `backtest/lib/triggers/trendline_break.py` module to detect trendline breaks and will veto call entries when a break is confirmed.
